product: Roadshock 14 in. Spot/Flood Combo LED Light Bar
summary: Combo beam pattern chart and specs from the Roadshock 14 in. light bar box (SKU 64321): 360 lx at 30 ft, 1 lx at 600 ft, 0.25 lx at 1000 ft.
body: This is the beam pattern chart printed on the retail box of the Harbor Freight Roadshock 14 in. Spot/Flood Combo LED Light Bar, item 64321. Harbor Freight's product page lists the lumens and the 1115 ft. range, but it doesn't show this chart or any lux readings.

The chart is a top-down view of the beam. The light levels printed along the top line up with the distances printed along the bottom: 360 lx at 30 ft, 1 lx at 600 ft, and 0.25 lx at 1000 ft. The side scale runs 90 ft to each side of center. The combo pattern is wide close to the light and narrows into a long spot beam.
The box also lists lumens, beam distance, color temperature, voltage, and wattage (below). Those match the product page.
transcription:
COMBO BEAM PATTERN
360 lx      1 lx      0.25 lx
30ft        600ft     1000ft
(side scale: 90ft 60ft 30ft 0ft 30ft 60ft 90ft)

SPECIFICATIONS
Lumens: 3000
Beam Distance: 1115 ft.
Color Temperature: 6250K
DC Volts: 12/24
Wattage: 47
FOR OFF-ROAD USE ONLY

ITEM 64321
transcription_notes: The first digit of "360 lx" is partly covered by clear tape on the box. It appears to read 360. A small round sticker unrelated to the product was blurred in the photo.
